I've seen a few reviews of this pedal and I have to say I'm not disappointed. The warm, authentic valve drive you get is just heartwarming. Not surprising since there's an actual valve inside. You can get anything from a mild boost to classic rock and heavy crunch. With the gain dimed and the boost engaged it will even take an already driven amp in to metal territory. I prefer to have it set to mid gain and use the guitars' volume to clean it up (which it does extremely well) and then use the boost side as a solo boost. Cant recommend this pedal enough. The included powersupply is a bonus too.
